body:
# FORGE YOUR DESTINY ON AETERN

AeternalCiv is a GEOPOLITICAL civilization building minecraft server made especially for those looking to forge their own path. With a focus on a player created world you choose what you become, and no matter who you are, you are welcome.

### Featuring:
- Reinforcement (Citadel)
- Snitchmod
- Slimefun
- Movecraft
- Origins
- Brewery
- ValhallaMMO
- Seasons
- Levelled Mobs
- RPG mechanics
- Custom recipes
- More on the way!

_Originally created for a group of 4 friends, we are looking for others so we can forge our Aeternal Destiny together!_

_Server is in active development and will be for sometime, anticipate additional changes and new mechanics._

## Join us today!
- SERVER IP: play.aeternalciv.com
- DISCORD: https://discord.gg/dwK2gnbAmn
- REDDIT: https://www.reddit.com/r/AeternalCIV/
